integrity: The maximum size eight is known prior work. The new claims are the complete labeled equality count and exact Cartesian-decomposition stratification. Two distinct complete clique recursions produce the rooted counts; a separate exhaustive two-use census and independent formula checks reproduce the decomposition counts.
scientific_limitations: The finite census applies only to three independent uses of the seven-antihole confusability channel, with fixed labeled residue symbols. Decomposability is defined by one-coordinate versus two-coordinate Cartesian cuts. The result does not classify under all graph automorphisms or give longer-blocklength or capacity claims. An unindexed finite census remains a literature risk; the 2013 two-factor paper was checked at abstract level only.
title: Exact census and decomposability of optimal three-use seven-antihole codes
